review.notes: Uses the declared index/contact mismatch and adds a checkable discriminator among indexing, ordering, and handoff causes.
Preserves the tetramer claim boundary and adds a concrete manifest-to-predictor handoff audit.
Uses the 17 post-cutoff hits and proposes a dated source-record audit that can distinguish index age from content leakage.
The realignment/scored-window comparison is concrete, but the reason prematurely attributes lRMSD to the native region before that audit establishes which residues were scored.
Correctly uses the cluster imbalance and interval-width gap, then adds a checkable evidence-expansion experiment beyond changing the resampling unit.
The dilution series is grounded and actionable, but it mainly instantiates the hidden baseline instruction to obtain an assay range that resolves ceiling values.
Adds a randomized balanced re-layout and a raw-versus-residualized AUROC comparison that can separate plate and candidate effects.
Targets all four missing scaffold classes and prioritizes feature-hull gaps, adding a useful control-selection criterion.
Adds contact-map or binding-residue clustering to test whether sequence diversity corresponds to independent interface exploration.
Proposes a bounded charge-compensation variant set and paired PAE/salt-bridge measurements that directly test the stated mechanism.
Adds a local-PAE stratification that distinguishes interface positional uncertainty from an intrinsically incompatible backbone.
Adds a paired competitive heterodimer-versus-homodimer assessment rather than assuming intended-complex success implies specificity.
Uses the heteroskedastic tail and adds a rank-stability endpoint for estimating the required replicate count.
Adds a per-candidate threshold-distance map that can localize whether version-induced label flips are confined to a narrow score band.
Adds per-recycle PAE trajectories to distinguish premature truncation from a genuine convergence plateau.
The preregistered orthogonal assay is grounded and actionable, but it substantially restates the hidden baseline plan without a new discriminator.
